"SELECT  sbsb.sbsb_ck , sbsb.sbsb_id, grgr.grgr_id as GroupId
FROM Facets.cmc_sbsb_subsc sbsb 
INNER JOIN  Facets.cmc_grgr_group grgr on sbsb.grgr_ck = grgr.grgr_ck 
AND sbsb.SBSB_RETIRE_DT = TO_DATE(''1/1/1753'', ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
JOIN Facets.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME on MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK
JOIN Facets.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK AND 
MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND=''Y'' and (sysdate between MEPE.mepe_eff_dt AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT or MEPE.mepe_eff_dt > sysdate)
and to_char(MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT, ''DD-MM-YYYY'' ) = ''31-12-2199''
AND (grgr.grgr_id in
(
select GroupId from  AGP.ERRORGROUP where (GroupId like ''%MCRWP0'' OR GroupId like ''%PDP%'')
) or grgr.grgr_id in (''FLMCR000'',''GAMCR000'',''NJMCR000'',''NMMCR000'',''NYMCR000'',''TNMCR000'',''TXMCR000'',''WAMCR000''))
and sbsb.sbsb_ck in (
select  sbsb.sbsb_ck
from Facets.cmc_sbsb_subsc sbsb 
inner join Facets.cmc_grgr_group grgr 
on sbsb.grgr_ck = grgr.grgr_ck
and (grgr.grgr_id in (select GroupId from   AGP.ERRORGROUP where (GroupId like ''%MCRWP0'' OR GroupId like ''%PDP%'')) 
or grgr.grgr_id in (''FLMCR000'',''GAMCR000'',''NJMCR000'',''NMMCR000'',''NYMCR000'',''TNMCR000'',''TXMCR000'',''WAMCR000''))
inner join Facets.cmc_meme_member meme 
on sbsb.sbsb_ck = meme.sbsb_ck
JOIN Facets.CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 
AND MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND=''Y'' 
and (sysdate between MEPE.mepe_eff_dt AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT or MEPE.mepe_eff_dt > sysdate)
join ( select mem.meme_ck,max(mem.memd_hcfa_eff_dt)  as memd_hcfa_eff_dt ,max(mem.memd_hcfa_term_dt) as memd_hcfa_term_dt  from Facets.cmc_memd_mecr_detl mem where mem.memd_event_cd = ''LICS''
and MEMD_LICS_SBSDY <> 0  
group by mem.meme_ck
) memd
on memd.meme_ck = meme.meme_ck
and memd_hcfa_eff_dt between MEPE.mepe_eff_dt AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
and memd_hcfa_eff_dt <= MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
and sysdate between memd.memd_hcfa_eff_dt and memd.memd_hcfa_term_dt
join Facets.cmc_memd_mecr_detl memd1 
on memd1.meme_ck = memd.meme_ck
and memd1.memd_hcfa_eff_dt = memd.memd_hcfa_eff_dt
and memd1.memd_event_cd = ''LICS''
left join ( select sbsr0.sbsb_ck,sbsr0.sbsr_eff_dt as sbsr_eff_dt ,sbsr0.sbsr_term_dt as sbsr_term_dt,sbsr0.pdbl_id, sbsr0.sbsr_sb_mod_amt from  Facets.CMC_SBSR_SB_RATE SBSR0
where sbsr0.pdbl_id = ''LIS''
and sbsr0.sbsr_sb_mod_amt <>0 
) SBSR0
on sbsr0.sbsb_ck = sbsb.sbsb_ck
and sbsr0.sbsr_eff_dt between MEPE.mepe_eff_dt AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
and (SYSDATE between sbsr0.sbsr_eff_dt AND sbsr0.sbsr_term_dt or sbsr0.sbsr_eff_dt > sysdate)
AND sbsr0.pdbl_id = ''LIS''
LEFT OUTER join Facets.CMC_SBSR_SB_RATE SBSR 
on sbsr.sbsb_ck = sbsr0.sbsb_ck
and sbsr.sbsr_eff_dt = sbsr0.sbsr_eff_dt
and sbsr.sbsr_term_dt = sbsr0.sbsr_term_dt 
AND sbsr.pdbl_id = ''LIS''
and sbsr.sbsr_sb_mod_amt = sbsr0.sbsr_sb_mod_amt
AND  sbsr.sbsr_eff_dt  between memd.memd_hcfa_eff_dt AND memd.memd_hcfa_term_dt  
and sbsr.sbsr_eff_dt between MEPE.mepe_eff_dt AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT
and ABS(round(sbsr.sbsr_sb_mod_amt)) = ABS(round(memd1.MEMD_LICS_SBSDY)) 
where SBSR.sbsb_ck IS NULL
UNION

sbsb.sbsb_ck

inner join Facets.cmc_grgr_group grgr

and memd_hcfa_eff_dt between MEPE.mepe_eff_dt AND MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT

on memd1.meme_ck = memd.meme_ck
and memd1.memd_hcfa_eff_dt = memd.memd_hcfa_eff_dt
and memd1.memd_event_cd = ''LICS''

and ABS(round(sbsr.sbsr_sb_mod_amt)) = ABS(round(memd1.MEMD_LICS_SBSDY))

@concat('"select  distinct sbsb.sbsb_ck,sbsb.sbsb_id, grgr.grgr_id as GroupId, ''12'' as ErrorTypeId
from Facets.cmc_sbsb_subsc sbsb inner join Facets.cmc_grgr_group grgr on sbsb.grgr_ck = grgr.grgr_ck 
join Facets.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM SBSP on  sbsb.sbsb_ck = sbsp.sbsb_ck
where SBSP.sbsb_ck in 
(
WITH Sdates AS (
 SELECT a.sbsp_eff_dt,a.sbsb_ck
 FROM Facets.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM  a
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM Facets.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM  b
                  WHERE a.sbsb_ck=b.sbsb_ck
                   AND a.sbsp_eff_dt IN (b.SBSP_TERM_DT,b.SBSP_TERM_DT+1) 
                   and EXTRACT(YEAR FROM b.SBSP_TERM_DT) <> ''9999'' )),
                 
Edates AS (
 SELECT a.SBSP_TERM_DT,a.sbsb_ck
 FROM Facets.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM a
 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM Facets.CMC_SBSP_SPLT_PREM  b
                  WHERE a.sbsb_ck=b.sbsb_ck
                   AND a.SBSP_TERM_DT IN (b.sbsp_eff_dt,b.sbsp_eff_dt-1)))
SELECT s.sbsb_ck
FROM Sdates s
INNER JOIN Edates e ON e.sbsb_ck=s.sbsb_ck
                   AND e.SBSP_TERM_DT>=s.sbsp_eff_dt
GROUP BY s.sbsb_ck having COUNT(*) > 1
)
and (grgr.grgr_id in (select GroupId from   "', variables('gv_GroupTable'), '" where (GroupId like ''%MCRWP0'' OR GroupId like ''%PDP%'')) 
or grgr.grgr_id in (''FLMCR000'',''GAMCR000'',''NJMCR000'',''NMMCR000'',''NYMCR000'',''TNMCR000'',''TXMCR000'',''WAMCR000''))
"')
